title: We Gather Together
description: We Gather Together in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are anonymous, in print by 1597. The English translation is by Theodore Baker (1894). The tune, KREMSER, is Traditional Dutch. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: We ga-ther to-ge-ther to ask the Lord's bless-ing; He cha-stens and ha-stens His will to make known. The wi-cked op-pres-sing now cease_ from dis-tres-sing. Sing prai-ses to His Name;_ He for-gets not His own.

lines: We gather together to ask the Lord's blessing;
He chastens and hastens His will to make known.
The wicked oppressing now cease from distressing.
Thou, Lord, were at our side,
